note: All statistics describe the SYNTHETIC output only; they are not properties of any client source data.

entity_repetition.sparsity_note: entities typically observed in a contiguous-ish window with gaps; not a full Cartesian grid

transitions.definition: entity-month flag = any Non_Compliant row for the EON_ID in that month; consecutive observed months only

golden_questions.question: How many distinct applications reported in October 2026?
golden_questions.grain: Distinct EON_ID within the month filter.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EON_ID) AS DISTINCT_APPLICATIONS FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-10-31'

golden_questions.question: How many applications reported in all 12 periods?
golden_questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS APPLICATIONS_REPORTING_ALL_PERIODS FROM (SELECT EON_ID FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA GROUP BY EON_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE) = 12) X

golden_questions.question: How many rows are in each COMPLIANCE_STATUS in October 2026?
golden_questions.grain: Row counts (one row = app x metric x month), not application counts.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT COMPLIANCE_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-10-31' GROUP BY COMPLIANCE_STATUS ORDER BY ROW_COUNT DESC, COMPLIANCE_STATUS

golden_questions.question: What is the provisional compliance rate by reporting month?
golden_questions.status: PROVISIONAL (numerator/denominator rule is a generator assumption)
golden_questions.grain: SUM(IS_NUMERATOR)/SUM(IS_DENOMINATOR) at row grain across all metrics; metric variants A/B differ in denominator scope.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(IS_NUMERATOR) / NULLIF(SUM(IS_DENOMINATOR), 0), 4) AS PROVISIONAL_COMPLIANCE_RATE FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA GROUP BY REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE ORDER BY REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE

golden_questions.question: How many completed tests failed in each month?
golden_questions.grain: Row counts where TEST_STATUS = 'Test_Complete' and TEST_RESULT = 'Fail'.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE, COUNT(*) AS FAILED_TEST_ROWS FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE TEST_STATUS = 'Test_Complete' AND TEST_RESULT = 'Fail' GROUP BY REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE ORDER BY REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE

golden_questions.question: Which 5 SUPER_DIVISIONs have the most non-compliant applications in October 2026?
golden_questions.status: Unambiguous (an application counts once if any of its rows is Non_Compliant)
golden_questions.grain: COUNT(DISTINCT EON_ID) with at least one Non_Compliant row in the month.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT SUPER_DIVISION, COUNT(DISTINCT EON_ID) AS NON_COMPLIANT_APPLICATIONS FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-10-31' AND COMPLIANCE_STATUS = 'Non_Compliant' GROUP BY SUPER_DIVISION ORDER BY NON_COMPLIANT_APPLICATIONS DESC, SUPER_DIVISION LIMIT 5

golden_questions.question: How many applications became non-compliant in October 2026?
golden_questions.status: PROVISIONAL (definition of 'newly non-compliant' is an analyst assumption)
golden_questions.grain: App has a Non_Compliant row in the latest month, was reported in the previous month, and had no Non_Compliant row then.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NEWLY_NON_COMPLIANT_APPLICATIONS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT EON_ID FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-10-31' AND COMPLIANCE_STATUS = 'Non_Compliant') C WHERE C.EON_ID IN (SELECT EON_ID FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-09-30') AND C.EON_ID NOT IN (SELECT EON_ID FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-09-30' AND COMPLIANCE_STATUS = 'Non_Compliant')

golden_questions.question: Which 5 legal entities hold the most distinct applications in October 2026?
golden_questions.grain: COUNT(DISTINCT EON_ID) by LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME for the month.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT EON_ID) AS APPLICATIONS FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-10-31' GROUP BY LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME ORDER BY APPLICATIONS DESC, LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME LIMIT 5

golden_questions.question: How many M&A-associated applications have a non-compliant row in October 2026?
golden_questions.grain: COUNT(DISTINCT EON_ID) with IS_MERGERS_ACQUISITIONS_ASSET = 'Y' and a Non_Compliant row in the month.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EON_ID) AS MA_NON_COMPLIANT_APPLICATIONS FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-10-31' AND IS_MERGERS_ACQUISITIONS_ASSET = 'Y' AND COMPLIANCE_STATUS = 'Non_Compliant'

golden_questions.question: Which 5 primary business owners (fictional) own the most applications in October 2026?
golden_questions.grain: COUNT(DISTINCT EON_ID) by (PRIMARY_BUS_FIRST_NAME, PRIMARY_BUS_LAST_NAME) for the month.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT PRIMARY_BUS_FIRST_NAME, PRIMARY_BUS_LAST_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT EON_ID) AS APPLICATIONS FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-10-31' GROUP BY PRIMARY_BUS_FIRST_NAME, PRIMARY_BUS_LAST_NAME ORDER BY APPLICATIONS DESC, PRIMARY_BUS_FIRST_NAME, PRIMARY_BUS_LAST_NAME LIMIT 5

golden_questions.question: What is the average RFB per COMPLIANCE_STATUS in October 2026?
golden_questions.status: PROVISIONAL (RFB semantics are a generator assumption)
golden_questions.grain: AVG over rows with non-null RFB (row grain); row counts include null-RFB rows.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT COMPLIANCE_STATUS, ROUND(AVG(RFB), 3) AS AVG_RFB, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE REPORTING_MONTHEND_DATE = '2026-10-31' GROUP BY COMPLIANCE_STATUS ORDER BY COMPLIANCE_STATUS

golden_questions.question: What share of completed tests failed, by ASSET_RISK_RATING_2 (all months)?
golden_questions.status: PROVISIONAL (risk-code severity direction is not defined by the sources)
golden_questions.grain: Rows with TEST_STATUS = 'Test_Complete' and a non-null TEST_RESULT.
golden_questions.sql: SELECT ASSET_RISK_RATING_2, COUNT(*) AS COMPLETED_TESTS, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN TEST_RESULT = 'Fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS FAIL_SHARE FROM SYNTHETIC_ENTERPRISE_DATA WHERE TEST_STATUS = 'Test_Complete' AND TEST_RESULT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ASSET_RISK_RATING_2 ORDER BY ASSET_RISK_RATING_2
